text:
maria: quick heads-up — ran the int4+fp8 hybrid bench on rtx-pool this morning, seeing ~18% throughput lift but a few eval regressions on Squad-v2.
cheng: oof, can you paste the failing examples? are these gen-length or logits issues?
maria: pasted a short snippet below for two failing cases:
```
input: "How do I reset my password?"
output_fp32: "To reset your password, go to Settings > Account..."
output_int4fp8: "To reset your passport, go to Settings > Account..."  # small hallucination/substitution
```
sam: @maria can you link the run id? i'll pull kv-cache traces and latency hist.
maria: run id: rrun-2026-03-16-0312, logs -> https://internal/bench/rrun-2026-03-16-0312 (internal)
dev-bot: perf-bench finished: throughput +18%, p95 latency +12ms, regressions 6/5000 (squad-v2 mismatch metric)
leo: quick hypothesis — int4 quant for attention matmul might underflow for certain heads on long tokens. try enabling per-head scaling or fallback to int8 for attention.
cheng: i'll try a kernel fallback (int8 for attention, int4 for FFN) and rerun a smoke with the same seed. also adding per-head scale option to the quantizer.
maria: filed PR #2412 with feature toggles + exportable metric CSV; added the two failing examples in the PR description. cc @qa-bot for sample checks :thumbsup:
qa-bot: queued 50 sample evals against rrun-2026-03-16-0312, priority=high, ETA ~45m
sam: also propose adding a small CI canary that runs length=1024 on a single shard with hybrid quant enabled — catches tail-edge distribution issues earlier.
maria: agreed, i'll add a Jenkins job and a short post-deploy smoke in canary pipeline. thanks all.
cheng: update — initial rerun with attention=int8, FFN=int4 shows regressions drop to 1/5000, p95 latency still +9ms. pushing more runs now.
leo: if that persists, we should document the recommended default: attention=int8, ffn=int4 for safety, plus per-head scaling when available.
maria: note for release notes: mention hybrid-int4/fp8 option, recommended defaults, and the rare SQuAD substitution risk.
sam: thumbs up.
maria: closing loop when QA confirms.
